mentions.name: Lua feed engine
mentions.description: A Lua engine that generates RSS feeds for websites that don't natively support them, using AI to write the Lua feed scripts as a one-off. Still an early-stage experiment not ready for prime time.
mentions.problem: Many websites don't support RSS feeds.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’ve been playing around with a Lua engine to build feeds for websites that don’t support them, using AI to build the Lua as a once-off. It works reasonably well, but isn’t ready for prime time just yet.
mentions.author: hsx
